chapters.title: Chapter 23 Qi Cultivation Level 6_1
paragraphs: Within the Water Mansion, Chen Mobai sat upright on a cushion.
On his features emerged the radiant hues representing the Five Elements. Flashing one by one, they eventually turned into a profound, earthy color.

This indicated the complete cycle of the Five Elements Cultivation Technique. It then transformed into the color of white gold, gold engenders water... Five Elements regenerate, constantly spinning in turn. By the end of nine Grand Circulations, a bead of sweat appeared on Chen Mobai's forehead.
With a month's worth of cultivation, under the nourishment of Rank-2 spiritual energy inside the Water Mansion, his Five Elements Cultivation had successfully reached the zenith of the fifth layer.
When the time was right, he had to muster all his strength for the breakthrough.

This was what Master Qing Ping had said. Chen Mobai regarded his words as infallible, he had no room for uncertainty. Feeling on the verge of a breakthrough, he directly swallowed the Purple Fire Pill that was in his mouth.
Even though this barrier-breaking pill had only about a 20% to 30% efficiency rate for breaking through to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, it was the best Chen Mobai could afford.
Among the myriad of elixirs and spiritual water in Immortal Cultivation, those aiding cultivators in overcoming the barriers of their realm were always the most coveted.
In typical pharmacies, such pills are nonexistent, and even if there were any, they would at most increase the success rate by 5% to 10%.

Common cultivators who desire quality products place their hopes on the rare-to-release, high-quality pills produced by the large pharmacies or the official flagship stores of the Immortal Cultivation Orders.
Among them is the Purple Fire Pill.
Once the pill was swallowed, the outer coating of sugar was quickly dissipated by spiritual energy, and a warm Yang energy began to disperse, immediately spreading throughout his body.
Chen Mobai's Five Elements Cultivation, which was initially pushed to its limits, was swiftly elevated to the sixth layer as if it had received a great boost.
However, this did not mean he had successfully broken through.
It was easy to break into a new realm, but to solidify this realm without regression afterwards, that was what truly mattered.
A wisp of purple Qi started to surface faintly on his brow.
The purple Qi rose gently, like fireworks, but as if it was about to extinguish the very next moment.

This indicated the pill's effect was about to be exhausted, and Five Elements Cultivation was only more than halfway done with the Grand Circulation. If he couldn't complete a whole cycle of cultivation, it would mean that this breakthrough was a failure.
However, Chen Mobai was not anxious. He steadied his mindset, placing his hand on a Spirit Stone beside him.

Although it was his first time refining a Spirit Stone, he had already researched a good deal of related content on Auxiliary Cultivation Software. He thence had a good grasp of the essential points and taboos.
With the assistance of the Spirit Stone, the realm Chen Mobai was on the brink of slipping from was once again stabilized. He even comfortably completed a Grand Circulation.
Qi Cultivation sixth layer, accomplished!
Opening his eyes, the usually calm Chen Mobai couldn't resist but burst into laughter.
His month-long diligent effort was not in vain.

Of course, although the breakthrough to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation was the result of various factors, he clearly understood that the biggest contributor to his breakthrough within a month was Master Qing Ping's lecture videos.
A cultivator of the Nascent Soul Realm, with a lofty, far-sighted perspective, had thoroughly explained the Five Elements Cultivation in the Qi Cultivation Chapter.

Over the past month, Chen Mobai went through Master Qing Ping's videos in school during the day, practiced what he learned in the Water Mansion in the evening, coupled with the Rank-2 spiritual energy in the treasure land, the help of Purple Fire Pills and Spirit Stones, and he felt that if he still couldn't break through, he must be a fool.
"Should I prepare to switch my Cultivation Technique?"
After a moment of excitement, Chen Mobai quickly composed himself and returned to reality.

The Immortal Cultivation Order dictates that every cultivator, when embarking upon their journey of cultivation, must practice the Five Elements Cultivation. When they reach the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation, they can choose to continue with Five Elements Cultivation or switch to another Cultivation Technique.

The strengths and weaknesses of Five Elements Cultivation are quite evident. For cultivators with average Spirit Root Attributes, it can maintain a decent pace of cultivation, although their combat capability is average. However, the adaptable spiritual power brought about by Five Elements Cultivation can be seamlessly converted into any other attribute Cultivation Techniques.
Chen Mobai's mother, Tang Panchui, cultivates the Five Elements Cultivation. For many years, she has been stuck at the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, but she has a good mindset.

Chen Mobai's father, Chen Xinglan, on the other hand, has switched to a technique called "Melting Fire Technique", which he learned at Red Dawn Institution at his own expense. He is currently at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation and works in a workshop in a Magic Artifact factory. That company provides free lodging with access to Rank-1 Top-grade spiritual energy for its employees. To save some money, he spends most of his time living in company housing.

Chen Mobai's father, Chen Xinglan, on the other hand, has switched to a technique called "Melting Fire Technique", which he learned at Red Dawn Institution at his own expense. He is currently at the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation and works in a workshop in a Magic Artifact factory. That company provides free lodging with access to Rank-1 Top-grade spiritual energy for its employees. To save some money, he spends most of his time living in company housing.

The country's Immortal Cultivation Library has an artificial spiritual intelligence; when one enters their Spirit Root Attributes, it will automatically match the most suitable Cultivation Technique script.
Only one point is needed to try out this feature.
Chen Mobai once tried it out when he was bored, and the artificial spiritual intelligence's result was the Five Elements Cultivation, causing his face to turn green instantly.
This meant that although he had a True Spirit Root, there was basically no difference from having a False Spirit Root.
But things are different now.
Thinking of this, Chen Mobai unlocked his mobile phone and opened the Immortal Cultivation National Library software.
But he immediately discovered that his phone had no signal.
"Almost forgot, only the 'Auxiliary Cultivation' software, represented by Turtle Treasure in the Water Mansion, has a signal..."
Chen Mobai glanced at the time. Although it was still early, he decided to head back early.

After using the Purple Fire Pill for a breakthrough, one cannot cultivate for a period of time and can only maintain their channels with the Qi Nourishing Technique. However, Chen Mobai used the pure spiritual energy from the Spirit Stone for the second half of the Grand Circulation, which seemed to neutralize the effect of the pill's Yang Fire, so he didn't feel the sensation of full channels like after breaking through to the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation.
It was as if without nurturing, the realm of the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation had already been solidified.
However, to be on the safe side, Chen Mobai didn't continue to cultivate that day.
There's no need to rush, Immortal Cultivation also requires a balance of work and rest.
As he packed away the Spirit Stone that had been drained of its energy, a sudden pop-up message appeared on his cellphone screen.
[Enable Representation?]
Huh?
After a moment of surprise, Chen Mobai thought of the significant help Master Qing Ping's lecture videos had provided him and was about to click [Yes].

But just as his finger was about to press down, a thought suddenly struck him. He remembered seeing the Rank-5 light ring after the "Auxiliary Cultivation" software was represented, and his face went pale.
His hand shook, and he was scared into quickly clicking [No].
This was the National Library, the foundation of the Immortal Cultivation Order, not some minor software from a small workshop.
Once he became a Rank-5 user of the National Library, even if they had to turn the entire Earth-Origin Star upside down, the Three Grand Halls of the Immortal Cultivation Order would find the person.
But to decline this representation, Chen Mobai felt quite regretful.
He quickly opened the Turtle Treasure app and saw the [Representation] button illuminated, indicating that it could be used, which allowed him to let out a sigh of relief.
What exactly triggers this function?
Chen Mobai thought of his recent breakthrough to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, could it be that a breakthrough activated it each time?
But how come it took so many days the last time?
Was it because this breakthrough was perfect, and the realm was stable?

That company provides free lodging with access to Rank-1 Top-grade spiritual energy for its employees.
To save some money, he spends most of his time living in company housing.

The country's Immortal Cultivation Library has an artificial spiritual intelligence; when one enters their Spirit Root Attributes, it will automatically match the most suitable Cultivation Technique script.
Only one point is needed to try out this feature.
Chen Mobai once tried it out when he was bored, and the artificial spiritual intelligence's result was the Five Elements Cultivation, causing his face to turn green instantly.
This meant that although he had a True Spirit Root, there was basically no difference from having a False Spirit Root.
But things are different now.
Thinking of this, Chen Mobai unlocked his mobile phone and opened the Immortal Cultivation National Library software.
But he immediately discovered that his phone had no signal.
"Almost forgot, only the 'Auxiliary Cultivation' software, represented by Turtle Treasure in the Water Mansion, has a signal..."
Chen Mobai glanced at the time.
Although it was still early, he decided to head back early.
After using the Purple Fire Pill for a breakthrough, one cannot cultivate for a period of time and can only maintain their channels with the Qi Nourishing Technique.

However, Chen Mobai used the pure spiritual energy from the Spirit Stone for the second half of the Grand Circulation, which seemed to neutralize the effect of the pill's Yang Fire, so he didn't feel the sensation of full channels like after breaking through to the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation.
It was as if without nurturing, the realm of the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation had already been solidified.
However, to be on the safe side, Chen Mobai didn't continue to cultivate that day.
There's no need to rush, Immortal Cultivation also requires a balance of work and rest.
As he packed away the Spirit Stone that had been drained of its energy, a sudden pop-up message appeared on his cellphone screen.
[Enable Representation?]
Huh?
After a moment of surprise, Chen Mobai thought of the significant help Master Qing Ping's lecture videos had provided him and was about to click [Yes].
But just as his finger was about to press down, a thought suddenly struck him.
He remembered seeing the Rank-5 light ring after the "Auxiliary Cultivation" software was represented, and his face went pale.
His hand shook, and he was scared into quickly clicking [No].
This was the National Library, the foundation of the Immortal Cultivation Order, not some minor software from a small workshop.
Once he became a Rank-5 user of the National Library, even if they had to turn the entire Earth-Origin Star upside down, the Three Grand Halls of the Immortal Cultivation Order would find the person.
But to decline this representation, Chen Mobai felt quite regretful.
He quickly opened the Turtle Treasure app and saw the [Representation] button illuminated, indicating that it could be used, which allowed him to let out a sigh of relief.
What exactly triggers this function?
Chen Mobai thought of his recent breakthrough to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, could it be that a breakthrough activated it each time?
But how come it took so many days the last time?
Was it because this breakthrough was perfect, and the realm was stable?

chapters.title: Chapter 24 Qi-replenishing Spirit Water_1
paragraphs: Chen Mobai was conflicted.
Unquestionably, if Turtle Treasure were to manage his account at the National Library, the benefit to him would definitely exceed that of using the second-rate Auxiliary Cultivation software.
There's a strict hierarchical system in immortality cultivation world; the higher your cultivation level, the more privileges you enjoy.

And the National Library, unarguably one of the core treasures of immortality cultivation world, houses 84,000 Taoist books, said to cover everything. As long as cultivators reach the necessary level, they can peruse corresponding cultivation experiences, cultivation techniques, and cultivation secrets.
Even the seven techniques that can be cultivated up to the Spirit Transformation Stage, handed down by the immortality cultivation world, are among them.
However, only those with Nascent Souls are allowed to access this portion.

While Chen Mobai understands that you should do as much as you can based on your ability, and he is just a Qi Practitioner at the sixth level, even if he could see the Spirit Transformation techniques, he would only be able to look at them rather than practice them.
But it's in human nature to be curious.
If Turtle Treasure really achieves proxy success and raises his privileges to Rank 5, wouldn't he be able to browse the full content of the National Library?
Although downloading the full text still requires points, even seeing the beginning of the Spirit Transformation Stage techniques would make him happy.
But he still had a sense of reason.
He felt that he needed to find a foolproof plan, ensuring that the Immortal Cultivation world wouldn't tie him to the upgrade, before proceeding with the proxy.
Chen Mobai opened his user interface at the National Library, the account name was a line from an old poem that he found very cool as a child:
In the years to come, I shall become the Blue Emperor!
Looking at it now, it seemed a bit juvenile, but since only he knew about it, he had never bothered to change it over the years.
There was a small check mark after the account name, indicating that it had been verified through real-name authentication.
If this account were to be upgraded to a Rank-5 user, the immortality cultivation world would be at his door the same night, so he figured it was best to take things slow.
After calming down, Chen Mobai got up, packed up his things, and prepared to leave the Water Mansion.
Breaking through to the sixth level of Qi cultivation today was a joyful event. He couldn't be greedy or excessive, and risk going from joy to sorrow.

He packed the tin foil box that originally contained the Purple Fire Pill, the now gray and depleted Spirit Stone, as well as his drink bottles and snack bags, planning to take them home for recycling.
He was about to press the return key on his phone when he saw the three side halls that had always been closed.
These days, he had indulged in cultivation, and almost forgot that there were three side halls in the Water Mansion.
Forget about the two side halls that were sealed by the Thunder Method Prohibition, the Water Wave Compound Restriction, could now certainly be attempted to break.
"I'll buy more Green Arrow Talismans, and break it in the next few days."
Chen Mobai murmured to himself, then vanished in a flash of silver light.
At school.
The teacher was lecturing, and most of the students, including Chen Mobai, were individually engrossed.
In Immortal Cultivation, one's realm is of utmost importance.
After all, the higher the cultivation, the longer the lifespan. Therefore, knowledge can completely be acquired when cultivation encounters bottlenecks.
The teachers also knew this, so they just taught without minding the students' distractions.

Generally, teachers were either old and hopeless of reaching Foundation Establishment, like Ding Jinglue, or they wanted to revisit the four arts of Techniques, Pills, Instruments, and Arrays through teaching, while also earning some Good Deed Points. For instance, their class teacher Chai Deyun and array teacher Chanshi; the former had a cultivation bottleneck while the latter received a teaching task from Cinnabarite Institute. She was also studying array and deepened her foundation through teaching.
Chen Mobai was shopping online.
He had a great experience with the "Green Arrow Talisman" he bought last time. He placed another order at the same online shop.

This time, he was financially more capable. To ensure absolute security, he bought ten talismans at once. It cost him half of his savings, but he was not upset. After all, these Good Deed Points was something he got for nothing.
He also bought two more Wood Armor Talismans.
Spending money felt so good.

Moreover, Chen Mobai was incredibly lucky; he managed to snag two bottles of Qi-replenishing Spirit Water freshly put on sale by Jumang Daoist Academy. The Spirit Water was intermediate grade Rank-1 and could quickly fill up one's cultivation level after breaking through a realm.

For instance, after Chen Mobai had just broken through to the sixth level of Qi cultivation, if he drew spiritual energy and practiced Five Elements Cultivation on his own, he would roughly need two years to reach Perfection in the sixth level and try to break through to the latter stage of Qi cultivation.
But if he took the Qi-replenishing Spirit Water, this process could be significantly shortened.
According to the prescription, if one bottle was taken and cultivation was practiced in a place with ample spiritual energy, the efficiency of one day was the equivalent of ten days.
In other words, if Chen Mobai were to take this Qi-replenishing Spirit Water every day, he could reduce two years to 70 days and reach Perfection in the sixth-level Qi cultivation.
Many so-called young geniuses were nurtured by this Qi-replenishing Spirit Water.
However, there were pros and cons.
Firstly, the price was high, costing 200 Good Deed Points per bottle.

Secondly, although taking the Qi-replenishing Spirit Water would shorten the cultivation time, the foundation would be naturally unstable. The time needed to break through the bottleneck would be far longer than that for those cultivators who take each step steadily.
The bottleneck of the minor realm was not so serious, but if it was the major threshold of Foundation Establishment, with a shallow foundation, failure was almost certain.

Chen Mobai initially didn't plan to buy it, but after breaking through to the sixth level of Qi cultivation, he felt that if he worked hard, he might have a chance to promote to the seventh level of Qi cultivation before the college entrance examination.

The latter stage of Qi cultivation, that is a completely different story. It would basically guarantee him a place in one of the top ten universities. Even if the foundation was a little shallow, he could find ways to make up for it in the future.
Elder Qing Ping once said, realm comes first.
This Nascent Soul elder had experienced over 300 magic duels without a single loss in his cultivation life, and what he relied on was simply that his realm was higher.

When he was at Foundation Establishment, he fought Qi Practitioners; at Gold Core, he defeated those at Foundation Establishment; after reaching Nascent Soul, he only made moves on Gold Core cultivators, never confronting cultivators at the same realm.
Chen Mobai thought that Elder Qing Ping made a lot of sense.
In his fight at the Water Mansion, if he hadn't been at the mid-stage of Qi cultivation while the old man was at the third level of Qi cultivation, he probably wouldn't have been able to win.
So, upgrading realm is of the utmost importance.
This is why he bought the Qi-replenishing Spirit Water.

He was lucky. It was a fast-selling product that would usually be sold out within a minute of being put on sale. Each account was restricted to buying only five bottles. If Chen Mobai had not been refreshing Jumang Daoist Academy's official flagship store continuously, he might not have been able to get it.

It was a pity that he was not rich enough, otherwise he could have bought all five bottles. Even if he didn't use them himself, reselling them could have resulted in a small profit of a hundred Good Deed Points.
While regretting, Chen Mobai heard the bell signaling the end of class.

In the cultivation room at school, he didn't watch Elder Qing Ping's Five Elements Cultivation lectures this time, but searched for videos about breaking prohibitions. Thanks to his high privileges, he found more than three hundred methods similar to breaking the Water Wave Compound Restriction.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Tianhe Realm l
paragraphs: Aside from the videos, there were over a thousand articles, all bragging that their method of breaking the prohibition is the best.
Chen Mobai set up a filter, first for author level of Nascent Soul.
Instantly, there were only two videos and six articles left.
After reading them carefully, he only felt dizzy.
What the Nascent Soul-level people thought as basic prohibitive techniques were more like reference books to him.
There was no other choice but to search within the level of the authors who were in Qi Cultivation.
But there were just too many, so in the end, he had to start with the ones with the most views first.

Anyway, it would take two to three days for the Green Arrow Talisman to be delivered, so Chen Mobai began to slowly compare the prohibition-breaking methods of all kinds of extraordinary people on the auxiliary cultivation software and picked the ones suitable for himself to read in depth.
For the ones that were too difficult to understand, he would ask Mr. Ding for help. The latter was knowledgeable and talked tirelessly.
By the time he got the talisman and Qi-replenishing Spirit Water, Chen Mobai was confident about breaking the prohibition.
In the Water Mansion.

He first used the Array Flag to test, making sure that the power of the Azure Water Array was not connected to the prohibition, then he activated the Green Arrow Talisman to start breaking the prohibition.
The result proved that his preparation was quite thorough.

After being hit with three Green Arrow Talismans, the door of the right side hall shattered. This was caused by the result of the power of the water wave prohibition disappearing and the power of the Green Arrow Talisman not yet exhausted.
Chen Mobai quickly swung the Array Flag in his hand, using the Azure Water Array to capture the fragments of the broken stone door, one by one, and put them in the front hall.
Then, using the Cleaning Technique, he tidied up all the dust.
With the Array Flag in one hand and the Wood Armor Talisman in the other, he walked to the open door.
The hall was small and similar to a study room. Besides a big wooden table of 2 meters by 3 meters, the rest of the walls were lined with bookshelves, filled with scrolls, books, and papers.
Chen Mobai tossed six glass balls inside, rolling them around on every single surface in the hall, to make sure that there were no remnants of the prohibitive power before he stepped inside.

He arrived at the big wooden table which had a stack of white paper on it. There was also a pen holder, which held three brushes of different sizes. As well as an inkstone, its ink had already dried up, indicating that no one had used it in a long time.
There was also a book on the table with two lines of words on the cover.
“Azure Waves Mansion Revenue and Expenditure Records”!
“Year 6425 of the Primordial Era”!
There was also a signature in the lower right corner: Liu Yanpei from the Five Elements Sect.

After Chen Mobai had checked the desk, he looked around and found that most of the books on the bookshelves were account books, some recorded local customs, some introduced spells, alchemy, magic artifacts, formations, he even found “Blackwater Cultivation” among them.
There was a stool under the big wooden table. Chen Mobai went over and sat down.
He then picked up the account books on it to read through.

January, purchased a new batch of 200 Azure Blood Carp seedlings from the Liu Cultivator family, purchased 7 silver edge bamboos and 2 gold edge bamboos from Green Bamboo Ridge, total consumption of 370 Spirit Stones.
February, purchased 200 pounds of bait and 50 bottles of Spiritual Water for bamboo cultivation from Southstream Market, total consumption of 120 Spirit Stones.
March, 300 pounds of fish bait, 2 silver edge bamboos withered, purchased 5 bottles of pest control Spiritual Water, total consumption of 70 Spirit Stones.
April, 400 pounds of bait, 20 bottles of Spiritual Water, total consumption of 80 Spirit Stones.
May,..., 1 gold edge bamboo withered ...
The accounts end in October, with no record of any income throughout.
The accountant seemed to have been preoccupied with something at this point and had left Azure Waves Mansion.

Chen Mobai got up and walked over to the bookshelf, looking for the account book for the previous year, the year 6424 of the Primordial Era. Not just that year’s, but the account books for the next twenty consecutive years were also found on the shelf.
He took ten books and went back to the table to read again from the start.
Only when he turned to three years ago did he finally see some income.

In the eighth month of the year 6423 of the Primordial Era, 50 Azure Blood Crop had grown to lower-grade Rank-1, 30 were provided to the sect, and 20 were sold at Sky Meal Building in Southstream Market, earning 200 Spirit Stones.
In September, 70 lower-grade Rank-1 Azure Blood Crop were sold, earning 700 Spirit Stones.
In October, 20 lower-grade Rank-1 Azure Blood Crop were sold, earning 200 Spirit Stones.
After browsing through ten years of account books, Chen Mobai had reason to suspect that the person who was keeping the accounts might have pocketed quite a bit.

But at this point, he finally found out that the green carp he had eaten was actually called “Azure Blood Carp”. A carp seedling was worth 1 Spirit Stone and after raising it for three years, it could be sold for 10 Spirit Stones.
He looked at other ledger books and finally understood the origin of this Water Mansion.

Named “Azure Waves Mansion”, it was a sub-residence of the Five Elements Sect, a major sect in the Eastern Wilderness. The Azure Cloud Lake where it was located was a Rank-2 Spirit Vein. Every year, farming Azure Blood Carp and cultivating Jade Bamboo could earn some spirit stones.

However, being a major sect in the Eastern Wilderness, the reason they would send disciples here to open up new residences was not to earn Spirit Stones, but to satisfy the appetite of the higher-ups.
This Azure Blood Carp and Jade Bamboo shoots, after being skillfully prepared by a master chef, could be considered as delicious food in this world.

A Gold Core cultivator from the Five Elements Sect had tasted it once and couldn’t forget it. Fortunately, as it happened, Azure Cloud Lake had the conditions suitable for fish farming and bamboo cultivation, so they distributed this long-term task within the sect.

There was a cultivator named Liu Yanpei, who was at the ninth level of Qi cultivation. To accumulate Spirit Stones for exchanging Foundation Building Pills, he accepted this task and stayed in Azure Waves Mansion for twenty years.
He was diligent and every year he would buy fish seedlings, bamboo seeds, and even learned how to be a Beast Tamer to get a chance to present himself in front of the Gold Core cultivator.
After looking at the books about local customs on the bookshelf, Chen Mobai finally understood where he was.
This place was actually no longer Di Yuan Star.
It was a world of cultivation known as “Tianhe”.
No wonder his phone was out of service. He didn’t know how far this “Tianhe Realm” was from Di Yuan Star.
Chen Mobai quickly adapted to the idea of an alternate world, because the highest level of Immortal Gate warfare was to open up a world.

However, such wars were risky and a slight mistake could lead to the destruction of nations, so as soon as he knew he was in another world of cultivation, he decided to be more careful and hide his identity.
But the problem arose again.
How did he end up in this world?
What on earth was that turtle shell?

According to the manual from the brown-robed young man, it was now the year 6478 of the Primordial Era, and the accounts recorded by Liu Yanpei, the disciple of the Five Elements Sect, ended in the year 6425 of the Primordial Era.
Which meant, Liu Yanpei had left this Water Mansion over fifty years ago.
The old man who claimed to be Liu Yanpei’s disciple should have known something, but he was already dead.
As dawn was approaching, Chen Mobai picked two books he hadn’t read from the bookshelf, planning to head home.
That’s when he had a flash of insight.
“Wait a minute, if I’m not on Di Yuan Star anymore, then there’s no need to worry about the Immortal Gate searching for me..”

A Gold Core cultivator from the Five Elements Sect had tasted it once and couldn’t forget it.
Fortunately, as it happened, Azure Cloud Lake had the conditions suitable for fish farming and bamboo cultivation, so they distributed this long-term task within the sect.
There was a cultivator named Liu Yanpei, who was at the ninth level of Qi cultivation.
To accumulate Spirit Stones for exchanging Foundation Building Pills, he accepted this task and stayed in Azure Waves Mansion for twenty years.
He was diligent and every year he would buy fish seedlings, bamboo seeds, and even learned how to be a Beast Tamer to get a chance to present himself in front of the Gold Core cultivator.
After looking at the books about local customs on the bookshelf, Chen Mobai finally understood where he was.
This place was actually no longer Di Yuan Star.
It was a world of cultivation known as “Tianhe”.
No wonder his phone was out of service.
He didn’t know how far this “Tianhe Realm” was from Di Yuan Star.
Chen Mobai quickly adapted to the idea of an alternate world, because the highest level of Immortal Gate warfare was to open up a world.

However, such wars were risky and a slight mistake could lead to the destruction of nations, so as soon as he knew he was in another world of cultivation, he decided to be more careful and hide his identity.
But the problem arose again.
How did he end up in this world?
What on earth was that turtle shell?

According to the manual from the brown-robed young man, it was now the year 6478 of the Primordial Era, and the accounts recorded by Liu Yanpei, the disciple of the Five Elements Sect, ended in the year 6425 of the Primordial Era.
Which meant, Liu Yanpei had left this Water Mansion over fifty years ago.
The old man who claimed to be Liu Yanpei’s disciple should have known something, but he was already dead.
As dawn was approaching, Chen Mobai picked two books he hadn’t read from the bookshelf, planning to head home.
That’s when he had a flash of insight.
“Wait a minute, if I’m not on Di Yuan Star anymore, then there’s no need to worry about the Immortal Gate searching for me..”

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Immortal Turtle_l
paragraphs: Chen Mobai took out his phone and opened the “Turtle Treasure” app.
As he was about to press the glowing “Proxy” button, he remembered something else.
He exited from “Turtle Treasure”, opened the “National Library” app, and logged out of his own account.
“I wonder if it would work without an account?”
Muttering to himself, Chen Mobai hit the “Proxy” button. The screen then returned to his phone’s home screen.
[Please select the app to proxy.]
Huh?

How come last time it automatically selected “Auxiliary Cultivation”? Could it be that when the “Proxy” function is activated, if you’re using a certain app, it will automatically proxy it. But if activated from the Turtle Treasure app, it requires manual selection?
Chen Mobai didn’t give it much thought. He simply tapped on the icon for the “National Library” app.
Then another window popped up.
[No account detected, proxying not possible. Do you want to create a new account?]
Pretty user-friendly feature, huh!
Chen Mobai hit [Yes].
After some thought while entering the account name, the first phrase that comes to mind was: “Beside the peach blossom tree, I announce.”
This, coupled with his previous phrase “If I were the Blue Emperor someday” completes a poetic verse.
But upon a second thought fearing it could expose him, he decided not to be too artsy.
Inspiration struck him, and he entered two characters:
Turtle Immortal!
After completing the new account registration, the proxying commenced.
He watched as a cute little turtle emerged in the center of the “National Library” app he had opened. After making a little spin, it dived into his user avatar at the top right corner.

But this time, the situation was a bit different than when he proxied “Auxiliary Cultivation”. The little turtle struggled to climb around his avatar, implying that the “National Library” had greater defensive force than “Auxiliary Cultification”, preventing immediate breakthrough.
Eventually, his permission level was only elevated to just short of four rings of light, after which the turtle could no longer move and vanished.
Rank-3 user.
This signifies a Gold Core cultivator.
Seeing this, Chen Mobai breathed a sigh of relief. However, there was a hint of disappointment in his heart.
It seems that Turtle Treasure is not omnipotent, indicating that there are forces within the Cultivation World that can suppress it.
However, this worked out just fine. If he was elevated to Rank-4 user, the Cultivation World would immediately be able to trace and detect that his new alias, Turtle Immortal, was problematic.
After all, in the entire Cultivation World, every Nascent Soul senior is well-documented. A sudden appearance of a mysterious Turtle Immortal would undoubtedly raise suspicion.
Shelving his thoughts, Chen Mobai excitedly opened the successfully proxied “National Library” app.
He wondered what the difference was between his current Rank-3 permissions and his previous Rank-1 permissions.
The interface hadn’t changed much.
He read the user guide and was pleasantly surprised by what he found at the beginning.

As a Rank-1 user, you had no say in the choices offered by the National Library - you could only read the Cultivation Techniques they provided. However, for Rank-3 users, there’s a great degree of freedom.

You just have to enter your ideas, predicted objectives, and even the resources you possess, and the National Library’s artificial intelligence will comprehensively integrate various conditions, compare the 84,000 dao books in their collection, and prioritize and list 30 cultivation techniques for you to choose from.
In a sense, the National Library is 95% accessible to Rank-3 users.
As for the next level, Rank-4 users that have reached the Nascent Soul stage, the number of valuable Dao books and cultivation techniques they find useful can be counted on one hand.
Chen Mobai, keeping his growing excitement under control, typed in his Spirit Root Attributes in the search bar, and then hit the search key.
Instantly, thirty cultivation techniques appeared.
Five per line, over six lines.
The first one was still the “Five Elements Cultivation”!
Chen Mobai clicked to check it out, finding it to be the complete version which could cultivate until the Nascent Soul stage. He was about to download it when a pop-up appeared.
[Insufficient points. Unable to download.]
It turns out that even the most noble users can’t freeload.
Rank-3 users get 30% off, but the problem is that Turtle Immortal is a new account with zero points.
However, Chen Mobai didn’t plan on taking all the advantages. Thus, he calmly closed the Five Elements Cultivation page and continued to explore other techniques.
“Immeasurable Cultivation”, “Water Splendor Sword Code”, “Profound Yin Great Method”, “Nine Bend Diagram”, “Ten Thousand River Book”, “Jade Purity Scripture”, “Pure Yang Scroll”...
Every book had a more impressive title than the last, becoming increasingly outrageous towards the end.
“Jade Purity Scripture” is the premier teaching of Primordial Elemental Academy, one of the only seven great methods in the Cultivation World that can train one to reach the Primordial Spirit.
And the “Pure Yang Scroll” refuses to be overshadowed, being the supreme method of Pure Yang Academy and a technique that leads to Primordial Spirit.
But after looking further, Chen Mobai came to understand a principle.
All paths lead to the source.

Even though the National Library holds 84,000 Dao books, these books essentially all derive from the seven Primordial Spirit techniques. Regardless of your Spiritual Root, if you intend to achieve Dao, you will eventually end up on one of these seven paths.

As a Rank-3 user, Chen Mobai is being offered at least Nascent Soul Formation techniques by the artificial intelligence, who assumes that he has the potential to achieve the Primordial Spirit. Therefore, according to his Spirit Root Attributes, “Jade Purity Scripture” and “Pure Yang Scroll” are included in the list of thirty cultivation techniques.

Among these, “Jade Purity Scripture” can be considered the ultimate version of Five Elements Cultivation. It doesn’t require particularly high Spirit Root Attributes, and is in fact, optimal for balanced Five Elements Attributes.
However, the difficulty of cultivating “Jade Purity Scripture” is extremely high, and can only be understood after reaching the Nascent Soul stage.
Thus, Chen Mobai clicked into it enthusiastically, only to find out his access was limited - he could only read the introductory summary and contents list.
Feeling somewhat deflated, he reviewed the summaries of all thirty cultivation techniques from beginning to end, trying to find the one most suitable for him.

“Immeasurable Cultivation” is a method from the Nature Studies Academy. Towards the end of the introduction, it stated that the magic potency cultivated through this method is pure and powerful. In a Magic Duel at the same level, it is unbeatable. However, it consumes massive amounts of Spiritual Energy and the cultivation speed is slow.

“Water Splendor Sword Code” is a Sword Cultivation method from the Mountain Sea Academy. It focuses on solidifying water into swords, refining swords into arrays. Once mastered, you can stand up to a multitude, especially when near a water source.
Comparing the descriptions, each book seemed more impressive than the last, leaving Chen Mobai, who suffered from difficulty in making choices, extremely hesitant.
But soon, he came to a realization.
This new account, “Turtle Immortal”, has zero points.
He cannot download any of the thirty cultivation techniques.

Even with his main account, “Blue Emperor”, only had over 3000 points. This represents that from his childhood to adulthood, he spent only 3000 Good Deed Points, of which almost 1000 of that were recently added when he purchased the Green Arrow Talisman and Qi-replenishing Spirit Water online.
There was simply nowhere he needed to spend money.
Chen Mobai opened the last book, “Pure Yang Scroll”.
Although this book is also a Primordial Spirit technique, when compared to the high entry barrier of “Jade Purity Scripture”, it had a more gradual and clear progression path..

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Immortal Technique - Mending
paragraphs: the Heaven_l
The “Pure Yang Scroll” was divided into five sections, correlating to the five major realms of Qi cultivation, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul and Divinity Transformation.
What’s more, the requirements for spiritual root attributes for cultivating the
“Pure Yang Scroll” were not high.
However, there was one prerequisite.
That was the need to cultivate a corresponding Daoist body.
This Daoist body was known as the “Pure Yang Daoist Body”!

The cultivation of the “Pure Yang Daoist Body” also had levels, from one yang to nine yangs. One had to reach a level of three yangs, then six, and finally achieve perfection when they reached “Pure Yang”.
For instance, if one wanted to establish the foundation, they would need to
first cultivate to a Three Yang Body.
If they desired to form their core, they would need a Six Yang Body.
For the Nascent Soul Realm, a prerequisite would be having a Nine Yang Body.
Upon reading this, Chen Mobai stumbled upon something familiar.

The process of cultivating to a Three Yang Body was the same technique that old man Ding had painstakingly used to enhance his spiritual roots when he was young. No wonder the Pure Yang Academy recruited him without trials once he had cultivated this technique.
Unfortunately, Old Ding had never managed to successfully establish his foundation.
But wasn’t the Three Yang Body a Daoist body? What did it have to do with enhancing the spiritual roots?

With this question in mind, Chen Mobai wanted to continue reading, but he found out that he lacked enough points. He could only see the overview and table of contents for the Pure Yang Scroll, not the specific method to cultivate the Three Yang Body.
Cursing silently, he found another way.
He opened the “Auxiliary Cultivation” software and entered the search term
“Pure Yang Daoist Body”.
Sure enough, all roads lead to Rome.
About two hundred pages appeared, showing that there were indeed quite a few cultivators who focused on the Pure Yang Scroll, offering a multitude of reference points.
Chen Mobai opened the highest-ranked video in the search results, posted by a
Core Formation cultivator named “Shaoyang .
“Although the Pure Yang Daoist Body is a Daoist cultivation technique, it has its roots in the spiritual roots,” he explained.

“Although the ‘Pure Yang Scroll’ is as difficult as the ‘Jade Purity Scripture’, Yuan Yang, the ancestor who achieved divinity, formulated the cultivation method of the Pure Yang Daoist Body along with the ‘Pure Yang Scroll’, significantly reducing the difficulty of cultivation.”

“The Pure Yang Daoist Body, from the birth of the first yang to the ascension of the ninth, requires 27 points of wood spiritual root, 27 points of water spiritual root, and optimally, more than 20 points of fire spiritual root. In essence, this ensures that the final perfection would undoubtedly be a 100-point fire attribute Immortal Spirit Root.”
After listening to this Shaoyang cultivator’s explanation, Chen Mobai understood why the art of the Three Yang Body was also a technique for enhancing spiritual roots.

It turned out that the original version of the “Pure Yang Scroll” had equally high requirements, requiring a baby born at the yang year, yang month, yang day and yang hour to cultivate it, essentially needing a Pure Yang Body.
The immortal Sect on Earth’s Adeptus Planet had upper echelons who calculated birth dates and manipulated childbirth cycles to have their lower-level cultivators sire infants with Pure Yang Bodies.
One amongst them had great accomplishments, and he was Yuanyang, the founder of the Pure Yang Academy.

However, he was a scholar who prioritized cultivating the younger generation and devoted himself completely to education. In order to spread the teachings of Pure Yang widely amongst the people and make it accessible to most cultivators, he created a technique to cultivate a Pure Yang Body.
This was the “Pure Yang Daoist Body”!
Yuanyang, the ancestor, originated from the Repairing Heaven Institute and had personally experienced the power of “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven”. He took his inspiration from there.

The “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven” was a technique that the ancestors of the Immortal Sect had gleaned from the heavenly scriptures. Once implemented, it could rebuild a cultivator’s spiritual root attributes, going against the heavens.
For example, Chen Mobai’s spiritual root attributes before consuming the
Azure Blood Carp were:
Gold: 23, Wood: 27, Water: 23, Fire: 17, Earth: 10.
Added together, these five elements spiritual root attributes equaled 100, and this was granted by Heaven, purely left to luck.
However, “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven” allowed for the deliberate modification of this allocation.
Using a layman’s terms, it was point redistribution.
If Chen Mobai were to use “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven”, he could designate a specific attribute, then reallocate points from the remaining four attributes to the chosen attribute.

For instance, if he favored wood, he could convert the attributes of gold (23), water (23), fire (17), and earth (10) to non-attribute points and then allocate all of them to the wood spiritual root, immediately achieving a perfect 100-point wood attribute Heaven Spiritual Root.
Such a 100-point spiritual root had another name within the Immortal Sect, referred to as an “Immortal Spirit Root”.
Such individuals never appeared naturally in the world; only “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven” could accomplish this.
The ancestor Yuanyang was the recipient of the baptism of “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven”, rebuilding his spiritual roots into a 100-point fire attribute Immortal Spirit Root.
An “immortal Spirit Root”, along with a “Pure Yang Body”, made for a rapid cultivation process.
He achieved the Primordial Spirit level in a mere 500 years, marking him as the fastest cultivator to reach Divinity Transformation in the recorded history of the Immortal Sect.
However, the divine technique could only be performed by cultivators at the Divinity Transformation level, and it would consume a significant amount of Elemental Energy.

Therefore, no one had been blessed to experience it in the last thousand years. Suppressing the excitement within his heart, Chen Mobai watched the entire video where Shaoyang explained the principles of the Pure Yang Daoist Body, and finally understood why it required 27 points of the Wood Spirit Root, 27 points of the Water Spirit Root and ideally, more than 20 points of the Fire
Spirit Root.
The Way of Heaven functions in a manner where it dims the bright and supports the weak.
The cultivation of the Pure Yang Daoist Body follows the principle where it harms the “Water and Wood” to bolster the “Fire .

Following the theory of the Five Elements generating each other, a cultivator’s water attribute spiritual root points are transformed into wood attribute points, which are subsequently converted into fire attribute points, thus achieving effects akin to using the “Immortal Technique-Mending the Heaven”.

Cultivation for each level of yang depends on a cultivator’s talent, comprehension, and resources. It can decrease a maximum of 3 points of Water Spirit Root and 3 points of Wood Spirit Root, but through the Pure Yang secret techniques, it can increase one’s Fire Spirit Root by 9 points.

If one successfully achieves Nine Yangs and they’re lucky enough to have increased by 9 points each time, then in the end, even a cultivator without a Fire Spirit Root can possess an 81-point Heavenly Fire Spiritual Root. If one initially had a 20-point Fire Attribute Spiritual Root, after adding the two together, it would directly surge to too, promoting one’s spiritual root to an Immortal Fire Spiritual Root.
Upon reaching this point, Chen Mobai, brimming with excitement, looked at his own spiritual root attributes.

He had the exact 27 points in his Wood Spirit Root and after consuming the Azure Blood Carp, his Water Spirit Root went from 23 points to 30, perfectly meeting the requirements for cultivating the Pure Yang Daoist Body.
Then he looked at his Fire Spirit Root, which was 17 points.
This was regrettable.
When the Nine Yangs are cultivated, they would add up to exactly 98 points. He was just 2 points short of achieving an Immortal Spirit Root.

Chen Mobai had already fantasized about cultivating the Pure Yang Daoist Body, achieving Divinity Transformation, sweeping over the whole world, proclaiming himself as Supreme and becoming an Ancestor.

He then watched a few more videos about the cultivation of the Three Yang Body and was immediately doused with cold water, his heart chilled. “The fastest cultivator to achieve the Three Yang Body was a cultivator named Ming Yang, who spent 12 years. He then spent an additional 39 years to achieve a Six Yang Body and finally spent 86 more years cultivating the Nine Yang Body. However, by that time, his lifespan was already depleted and he lacked the strength to push into the Nascent Soul Realm, eventually dying of old age..”

Cultivation for each level of yang depends on a cultivator’s talent, comprehension, and resources.
It can decrease a maximum of 3 points of Water Spirit Root and 3 points of Wood Spirit Root, but through the Pure Yang secret techniques, it can increase one’s Fire Spirit Root by 9 points.

If one successfully achieves Nine Yangs and they’re lucky enough to have increased by 9 points each time, then in the end, even a cultivator without a Fire Spirit Root can possess an 81-point Heavenly Fire Spiritual Root.
If one initially had a 20-point Fire Attribute Spiritual Root, after adding the two together, it would directly surge to too, promoting one’s spiritual root to an Immortal Fire Spiritual Root.
Upon reaching this point, Chen Mobai, brimming with excitement, looked at his own spiritual root attributes.

He had the exact 27 points in his Wood Spirit Root and after consuming the Azure Blood Carp, his Water Spirit Root went from 23 points to 30, perfectly meeting the requirements for cultivating the Pure Yang Daoist Body.
Then he looked at his Fire Spirit Root, which was 17 points.
This was regrettable.
When the Nine Yangs are cultivated, they would add up to exactly 98 points.
He was just 2 points short of achieving an Immortal Spirit Root.

Chen Mobai had already fantasized about cultivating the Pure Yang Daoist Body, achieving Divinity Transformation, sweeping over the whole world, proclaiming himself as Supreme and becoming an Ancestor.
He then watched a few more videos about the cultivation of the Three Yang Body and was immediately doused with cold water, his heart chilled.
“The fastest cultivator to achieve the Three Yang Body was a cultivator named Ming Yang, who spent 12 years.
He then spent an additional 39 years to achieve a Six Yang Body and finally spent 86 more years cultivating the Nine Yang Body.
However, by that time, his lifespan was already depleted and he lacked the strength to push into the Nascent Soul Realm, eventually dying of old age..”

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Primordial Yang Sword l
paragraphs: Although the Earth Star has entered the era of immortal cultivation, everyone’s lifespan has significantly increased, there are still natural life limits.
The Imperial Medical Academy has conducted a substantial amount of research on lifespan.
After sampling the lifespan limit of a hundred thousand regular cultivators, they concluded the maximum lifespan for each realm’s cultivators.
Qi Practitioners generally have a lifespan of two full cycles of the Chinese Zodiac, which is 120 years.
Foundation Establishment cultivators live for four cycles, 24.0 years.
Gold Core cultivators live for eight cycles, 480 years.
Nascent Soul cultivators double that, at sixteen cycles, or 960 years.
Of course, these figures aren’t absolute and can vary from person to person, but this is the average lifespan of standard cultivators.

If one practices a special cultivation technique, or correctly applies health preservation techniques, or consumes lifespan-extending spiritual medicine, then it’s possible to live a couple more zodiac cycles.
As for god-transcending cultivators, due to the lack of examples and insufficient samples, the Imperial Medical Academy didn’t release any information on that front.
However, based on the previous lifespan pattern, it should be thirty-two cycles, which equals 1920 years, a lifespan of two thousand years.
Chen Mobai’s greatest dream was to successfully achieve Foundation Establishment before the age of 60.
The Imperial Medical Academy also conducted research on cultivators breaking through major realms, and concluded: the rate of success in a breakthrough is highest before one’s lifespan is half over.

For example, Qi Practitioners wanting to establish the foundation are better off trying before the age of 60. Once past this age, no matter how they maintain their Qi cultivation, all kinds of bodily functions will begin to decline drastically.

Originally, Chen Mobai felt that he only had a 1% chance of establishing his foundation before 60, and though he now had the opportunity of the Mysterious Turtle Shell, he felt the possibility was merely 10%.
With the universal cultivation in Celestial Sword, there are three hundred million cultivators.
Those who can ultimately cultivate to the ninth level of Qi Practitioner are one in a hundred.

Among them, those who can successfully establish the foundation are again one in a hundred. The Imperial Medical Academy found, through data analysis of these successful cases, that over ninety percent succeeded establishing their foundation before the age of 60.
Once past 60, without enough vigor and essence, successful foundation establishments are either those with opportunities or are divinely favored.
Establishing the foundation is hard enough, and Core Formation is even harder. The success rate for this realm is one in a thousand.
As for the realm above Core Formation, the Nascent Soul, it hardly needs mentioning. It’s possible that not one appears across several eras.
Celestial Sword’s current Nascent Soul Masters are antiquities accumulated over a thousand years and a hundred eras.

Chen Mobai, with his average talent, had originally neither assurance nor expectations of establishing a foundation before 60, and if he were to additionally spend over a decade cultivating the Three Suns Body, he felt that he was basically done for.
So even though he cherished the “Pure Yang Scroll”, after considering many factors, he felt that he was best off honestly cultivating the “Five Elements Cultivation”.

Qing Ping was a good example right before Chen Mobai’s eyes. Using this most popular Qi cultivation technique, he was able to charge toward the goal all the way, and if he could form the Nascent Soul, then transitioning to the Jade Purity Scripture wouldn’t be a bad path to immortal cultivation either.
Old Man Ding was the bad example, a warning to emulate.
After admonishing himself silently, Chen Mobai suppressed the impulse to go out and trade the large Qing Emperor for the “Pure Yang Scroll: The Qi Cultivation Manual”.
However, even though he thought this way, he couldn’t help but download the tutorial video of Master Shao Yang explaining the cultivation of ‘Pure Yang Daoist Body’.
At least it would help pass the time during today’s class.
“Perfect timing to have a class with Old Man Ding today, I can ask him about the Three Suns Body.”
Murmuring to himself, Chen Mobai pressed the return key to the city.
Office.
“Teacher Ding, you are a disciple of the Pure Yang Academy, can you tell me the difference between the Great Dao Academy and the Four Daoist Academies?”

After class, Chen Mobai, following his usual practice, fell back one step, and while turning into the office to ask for advice on how to crack the Thunder Method Prohibition, he casually asked out of curiosity.
“In fact, according to the size of the student body and the strength of the faculty, the top-ranked Ten Academies are already not much different from the Four Daoist Academies.”
Old Ding loved to teach, and after listening to Chen Mobai’s questions, he shared what he knew.
“So, the difference lies in the cultivation techniques?”
Chen Mobai asked again, trying to steer the conversation towards the “Pure Yang Scroll”.
“The Primordial Elemental Academy and the Pure Yang Academy also possess a Divinity Transformation School, which is no less venerable than the traditions of the Four Daoist Academies.”
Old Ding shook his head.
“So what is the real difference?”
Chen Mobai didn’t dare to bluntly bring up the matter of cultivating the Pure Yang Body, so he could only continue along the line of Old Ding’s words.

“The Four Daoist Academies boast the oldest traditions, and each possesses a God-Transcending cultivator. The founders of the Ten Academies also originated from the Four Daoist Academies, so even if they momentarily surpass the latter, they all stay humble and dare not claim to be the Fifth Daoist Academy.”
“So, what exactly are the Divinity Transformation schools of the Four Daoist Academies?”

These were speculative topics commonly discussed online. Everyone offered different opinions, and Chen Mobai assumed that Old Ding knew the answer. To bring the topic back to the Pure Yang Academy, he kept pressing.

“Those are the highest secrets, only the uppermost figures would be clear about it. However, the dual saints of the Immortal Gate, one originated from the Dance Tool Dao Academy, and the other had studied in the Repairing Heaven Institute in his youth. He is still the honorary dean in name.”
The origins of the two God-Transcending old ancestors were well-known to all.
“However, I do know that the Pure Yang Academy possesses a Rank- 5 high-grade Primordial Yang Sword, which can also be classified as a God-Transcending foundation!”
Just as Chen Mobai was worrying about how to steer the conversation back, Old Ding himself began to talk about matters pertaining to the Pure Yang Academy.

“Among the entire Immortal Gate, there are only three Rank-5 high-grade flying swords. This Primordial Yang Sword was the result of the Primordial Yang ancestor burning his entire Dao Fruit before his death, thus reaching enlightenment. It is now a sentient weapon.”
“The Primordial Yang Ancestor’s eldest disciple used to control this sentient flying sword. They could slay anyone below the level of God-Transcending cultivator with a single strike.”

“However, the minimum requirement to operate this sword is at the Nascent Soul cultivator level, and if one refines it for a prolonged period, it will severely drain one’s essence, which is detrimental to cultivation. Therefore, when I entered the academy, this sword was already sealed and conserved. It is now revered in the hall, and I had the good fortune to pay homage to it once.”
Upon hearing this, Chen Mobai only felt sadness.
A majestic Rank- 5 high-grade flying sword was actually sealed up because there was no one to refine it.
“Isn’t it said that those who cultivate the Pure Yang Body are full of vigor? Why wouldn’t they be able to refine a Primordial Yang Sword?”

“That’s only possible if one fully accomplishes the cultivation of the Pure Yang Body. Even a Nascent Soul cultivator with a Nine Yang Body cannot withstand the spiritual energy drain of the Primordial Yang Sword day and night. Since they already worry about not having enough energy for their own cultivation, how could they possibly spare half of their daily cultivation energy for the sword?”
Old Ding rolled his eyes, and his words made Chen Mobai empathize greatly.

If it were him, he would absolutely refuse to give up half of his hard-earned daily cultivation energy for the Primordial Yang Sword before reaching the Grand Dao level, even if this sword was a God-Transcending artifact.

Considering that only a Nascent Soul cultivator can refine this sword, and that Nascent Soul cultivators view Divinity Transformation as their primary objective, how could they be willing to waste half of their cultivation time on a single sword?
“Isn’t it said that without long-term care and energy supply a magical weapon will degenerate in quality? Wouldn’t this waste the sacrifice of the Primordial Yang Ancestor?”

“Don’t worry, each Rank- 5 artifact is an invaluable cultural asset of the Immortal Gate. Every year, the Immortal Gate remits a certain amount of spirit stones from the national bank, allowing the Pure Yang Academy to preserve the Primordial Yang Sword without letting it degrade. It’s just a pity that the spirit stones allocated are earmarked for this purpose only. Otherwise, the Pure Yang Academy could at least save its students who are cultivating a Pure Yang Body half the time..”

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Insufficient Integration^
paragraphs: “Can the Spirit Stone reduce the time needed to cultivate the ‘Pure Yang Daoist Body’?”

Chen Mobai opened his eyes wide, unable to believe what he was hearing. “Cultivating the ‘Pure Yang Daoist Body’ is also a type of cultivation technique, and for any cultivation technique, one cannot lack spiritual energy. It took me twenty years to cultivate the Three Yang Body because at the time of transforming the spiritual root, the process of refining the spiritual energy delayed me. If there were Spirit Stones to aid me, it would have saved at least ten years of hard work.”
Old man Ding did not hide anything, he relayed his twenty years of experience from studying at the academy to Chen Mobai.

It turned out that during the cultivation of the Pure Yang Body, you also need spiritual energy to transform the spiritual root. Without a Spirit Stone, after depleting one’s own spiritual power, you have to absorb spiritual energy while transforming, making the efforts less effective.
Why didn’t the video of True Person Shaoyang mention this?
Chen Mobai was puzzled after listening, but he soon understood the reason.
Most of the Spirit Stones on Earth are owned by the state, and ordinary cultivators do not possess any.
Since they don’t have them, there’s no need to mention it.
In that case, the “Pure Yang Scroll” would not be impossible for Chen Mobai to cultivate.
There is indeed no channel within the Immortal Sects to obtain a large number of Spirit Stones, but it is not the same in the Tianhe Realm.

According to the account book of Azure Waves Lake, which Chen Mobai had read, the cultivation realm there did not seem to lack Spirit Stones. Even the Fei Zhenmen, a third-rate sect, could distribute Spirit Stones to each disciple as a benefit.
However, if he wanted to obtain Spirit Stones, he had to leave the Water Mansion and make contact with the real cultivation world of the Tianhe Realm.
Thinking of this, Chen Mobai hesitated again.

He remembered the two Tianhe cultivators who had died in the Water Mansion not long ago. Treacherous and ruthless behavior, stabbing people in the back, seemed to be the norm. Their words also told of the chaos and disorder of the
Eastern Wilderness.
The Tianhe realm was probably a place still in its feudal stage, in the obscure age of immortal cultivation, and risks were possibly present everywhere.

He hoped he wouldn’t get killed the moment he left the Water Mansion. Chen Mobai muttered to himself and asked Old Man Ding about the number of Spirit Stones needed to cultivate the “Pure Yang Daoist Body”.
-I’m not sure about that because I only heard about it from my seniors and didn’t experience it myself. You might need to find some ancient texts to confirm.”
Old man Ding frowned and shook his head.

About five thousand years ago, when Spirit Stones were still regularly circulated in the market, there were cultivators who used Spirit Stones to cultivate the Pure Yang Daoist Body. However, finding records of that distant era might take some effort.

Chen Mobai nodded, deciding to look for it when he goes back. If it doesn’t require many Spirit Stones, he would consider cultivating the “Pure Yang Scroll” after reaching the late stage of Qi Cultivation.
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Just then, there was a knock on the door.
“Come in.”
As soon as Old man Ding had spoken, his disciple, Song Zheng, opened the door.
“Master.”
Song Zheng bowed to Old man Ding, very respectfully, then looked at Chen Mobai with a slightly frowned brow, as if he was puzzled as to why he was here.
“Master Ding, I’ll come again next time to ask you about the Thunder Method Prohibition.”
Chen Mobai was very observant and did not linger to disturb the conversation between the master and disciple.
Although they were classmates, he and Song Zheng were not close. This was mainly because the latter was a diligent cultivator who would not waste time on socializing.
They both nodded at each other as a form of greeting.

After leaving the office, the first batch of senior three students in the cultivation room hadn’t come out yet, so Chen Mobai returned to the classroom, opened his phone, and searched about the relationship between the Pure Yang Daoist Body and Spirit Stones.
He finally found a related post on a forum.
The title of the post was: [How much time does it take to cultivate the Pure
Yang Daoist Body?]

It seemed a newcomer at the Pure Yang Academy had asked seniors for advice. There were more than fifty replies to the post, one of which mentioned using Spirit Stones to shorten the time needed to cultivate the Pure Yang Daoist Body. It seemed to be from a wealthier student at Pure Yang Academy. [My ancestors participated in the opening war and there were some Spirit Stones stored in the bank. After I was admitted to Pure Yang Academy, my family was excited and took out all the Spirit Stones for my cultivation. According to my own experience, here are some estimates for your reference.] [For the One Yang Body, if you want to achieve the best effect in transforming the spiritual root, you need 9 Spirit Stones. These 9 Spirit Stones should be used one by one according to the order of spiritual root transformation for the best results. Basically, in the end, you can increase your Fire Spirit Root by 9 points. This stage takes a month.]

[The Two Yang Body requires many more Spirit Stones. As there were not enough Spirit Stones in my home, part of this stage was fulfilled with my own refining of spiritual energy, eventually taking one year and three months.] [The Three Yang Body was cultivated purely by hard work without Spirit Stones, and it took six years to make a breakthrough.]

In the process of cultivating the Three Yang Body, this anonymous cultivator was five years ahead of True Person Ming Yang, who had the shortest time cultivating the Pure Yang Daoist Body without the use of Spirit Stones.
Chen Mobai was immediately enticed.
“I’ll first check out what’s outside the Water Mansion. If I can get a Spirit Stone, I’ll try to cultivate.”
Chen Mobai, who had originally planned to lay low, still couldn’t resist.

After all, there were only two months left before the college entrance examination, and his hope of breaking into the late stage of Qi cultivation was slim. If he could cultivate the One Yang Body, he might be able to get an admission notice from the Pure Yang Academy.

Thinking of this, he couldn’t resist logging into his main account in the National Library, but found that he didn’t have enough points to exchange for the Qi Cultivation chapter of the “Pure Yang Scroll”.

“Huh, why does the Qi Cultivation technique need so many points?” In Chen Mobai’s recollection, the Qi Cultivation chapter of Five Elements Cultivation only required 500 points. He had over 3000 points in his main account, which should have been more than enough to exchange for the Qi Cultivation chapter of the “Pure Yang Scroll”.
But when he looked, he found out it required 10,000 points.
Looking further, he was taken aback.

The Foundation Establishment chapter required 100,000 points, the Core Formation chapter required 1 million points, the Nascent Soul chapter required 10 million points, and the Divinity Transformation chapter directly required 100 million points. Moreover, each chapter had corresponding realm restrictions for download.

For example, Chen Mobai’s main account in the National Library, named ‘The Blue Emperor1, which was verified to have a Qi Cultivation Realm Level. Even if his account had 100 million points, he could only download the Qi Cultivation chapter of the “Pure Yang Scroll”.

“I’ll sell the Spirit Stone first. Recently, Jumang Daoist Academy puts up Qi-replenishing Spirit Water for auction every day, so I’ll use this good deed point to bid. I can increase my cultivation level with the Spirit Water while exchanging points for the Pure Yang Qi Cultivation chapter with the consumption.”
Although Chen Mobai is usually passive, he is always decisive when it comes to his cultivation.

A Spirit Stone left in hand is mere firewood, but it’s a treasure when put to use. He decided that under the primary premise of breaking through to the late stage of Qi Cultivation, if possible, he would also cultivate the Pure Yang Daoist Body.

Of the two Spirit Stones he obtained from the Water Mansion, one was consumed when he broke through to the sixth stage of Qi Cultivation, and one was left intact and unopened. If it was exchanged at the National Bank, it was worth 10,000 good deeds per piece.
If put on the market, due to supply and demand, it could be sold for at least 1,000 to 2,000 more good deeds..
